slides.prompt:
Create ONE finished Lightweight carousel slide by editing the FIRST attached image, a REF-001 TikTok web-viewer screenshot. The intended slide is ONLY the tall off-white LEFT panel, approximately x=171..1070 in the 2048-wide screenshot. Exclude all TikTok UI, top search bar and its gradient, arrows, pager dots, black margins and the whole dark comments panel on the right. Output a clean portrait PNG at 1080x1350 px, 4:5, not the screenshot.

The SECOND and THIRD images are approved WARM-SAND Lightweight series masters (LW-CAR-0001). Use them ONLY for the exact small black Lightweight wordmark, same top-left size/position, Rubik lettering style, palette and anatomical fine grey linework. Copy the supplied wordmark, never invent a logo. The FIRST image controls this slide's layout, figures, poses, equipment and text placement. DO NOT import the masters' centered numbered-circle layout, torso diagram, OR badge, headline, or poses into this source. Owner wants reference 1:1 with only the authorized substitutions, not a redesign.

Authorized palette/font changes: all source bright green -> coral #F26445 (highlighted muscles, accent words, #N numbers, short underline bars and thin exercise divider); source pale-green right-hand huge rounded arch -> #FBE3DD; background #F0F1EB; dark text #2A2A2A; grey body text #6B6B6B. Non-highlighted muscles MUST be warm sand #D9CBBE, shading only darker/lighter sand hues; skin/tendons ivory about #F5F0E5. Absolutely NO green, olive or sage tint on figures. Match exact source semi-realistic bald faceless anatomical mannequins, fine grey outlines, subtle muscle fibers, realistic black/grey/white equipment. ALL slide lettering Rubik: heaviest/black weight for cover, bold titles, regular body and exercise labels. Source font was narrower: scale Rubik to fit while preserving exact words and line breaks. Leave ample source-like whitespace. No unrelated decorations, signatures, watermarks or additional text. Keep every exercise label fully on canvas; pager occlusions in reference should be removed, not copied.

SLIDE 1 — COVER. Match first reference: three stacked huge uppercase lines across the top roughly half, centered, with the same line breaks:
STRUCTURE
THE PERFECT
PUSH DAY
First two dark #2A2A2A, third coral #F26445. Use heaviest Rubik, uniformly scale text within the original headline footprint, never shorten, never add a fourth line. Top-left small supplied Lightweight wordmark above headline like series master. Lower half: same FRONT-VIEW bald faceless anatomical man seated on the source grey PLATE-LOADED INCLINE/CHEST PRESS MACHINE, black incline seat/back pad, two large black plate stacks at sides, gripping both handles mid-press with elbows bent outward. Only BOTH PECTORALS coral; all other muscles warm sand and ivory tendons. Preserve machine's specific A-frame/lever shapes, pose, angle, position and relative scale from source, lower figure/equipment cropped at bottom as needed. Large pale arch on right. No exercise labels or other words.
slides.export_method: Uniform scaling to fit 1080x1350 and centered canvas extent with ImageMagick. No independent axis stretching or creative postprocessing. Original image-tool output retained.
